title: Remote viewing the inside of the Rendlesham triangular craft

tellings.quote: and I was the one that drew the u that went inside that triangular craft and actually drew the floor plans and the insides and all that.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant in a military remote viewing unit, says he used the mind alone to look inside the triangular craft reported in Rendlesham Forest, near the RAF Woodbridge air base in England, in the 1980s. He tells Michels he was 'the one that drew' the inside of that craft, including 'the floor plans and the insides and all that,' and he names another remote viewer, Ed Dames, in connection with the work. If true, it would mean the unit's psychics mapped the inside of an unknown craft.
